SELECT a.busiType, a.subjectName, a.busiTypeCode, a.subjectNameCode, DATE_FORMAT(a.HAPPEN_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as happenDate, a.ccy, a.ccy as ccyCode, a.cdFlag, a.cdFlag as cdFlagCode, a.happenAmt, a.dAmt, '' as balFlag, '' as balFlagCode, '' as oAmt, a.cAmt FROM (
select '01' as busiType, '01' as subjectName, '01' as busiTypeCode, '01' as subjectNameCode, '1' orderNum, vod.HAPPEN_DATE, vod.CCY as ccy, 'D' as cdFlag, sum(vod.HAPPEN_AMT) as happenAmt, sum(vod.HAPPEN_AMT) as dAmt, 0 as cAmt from BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL vod where vod.CD_FLAG = 'C' and vod.TABLE_ID in ('8004','8012','8032','8103','8105','0') and vod.SUBJECT_NO in ('22320101','22060101','22060201') and vod.HAPPEN_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{selectDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d') and vod.HAPPEN_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{selectDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d') group by vod.HAPPEN_DATE,vod.CCY
